notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 federation lifecycle surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies federation creation, duplicate creation rejection, named joining, duplicate membership and name rejection, automatic-resign directive boundaries and round trips, federate handle lookups, federation and member reports, destroy-while-joined rejection, ordinary resignation cleanup, missing-federation reporting, and joining a destroyed federation without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador federation execution lifecycle, federation/member queries, automatic resign directives, and FederateAmbassador lifecycle reports
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador federation and FederateAmbassador lifecycle declarations
